models.notes: Checked at this exact model: 1,152-zone Mini LED backlight on an IPS panel, flat rather than curved, DisplayHDR 1000, 90 W USB-C. The only 34-inch Mini LED IPS on this list, which is why it is here - it is the one way to get real local dimming without OLED's text and burn-in trade-offs. Brightness is the figure to distrust: retailer tables print 1000 cd/m2 peak while TFTCentral lists 600 cd/m2, and the two are not reconciled by anything consulted, so a deduction is recorded in _fit_penalties rather than a number being picked here. The 1000:1 contrast is the native panel ratio before the backlight dims, not what the Mini LED array achieves. KVM not mentioned either way; height adjustment confirmed present by a review but with no travel figure.

critic.verdict: 1,152-zone Mini LED backlight, DisplayHDR 1000, 99% DCI-P3, 10-bit; lists 600 cd/m2 brightness
